import sys

def run():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    a = data[1:1+n]
    t = data[1+n]
    a.sort()
    mx = 0
    j = 0
    for i in range(n):
        while j < n and a[j] - a[i] <= t:
            j += 1
        mx = max(mx, j - i)
    print(mx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
